detail.longDescription: Fabian Franz has a short way to think about AI agent security: social engineering, sniffing, and sending. His rule is that no single agent should hold all three at once, and that any text an agent reads, like reviews or calendar entries, is untrusted. Learn more: https://www. tag1.com/blog/how-to-think-abo ut-ai-agent-security/ # AIAgents # AISecurity # OpenSource
